source_row.stem: During a severe PPE shortage, "extended use" of an N95 respirator refers to:
source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Wearing the same respirator continuously for multiple client encounters without removing it between uses, as a crisis capacity strategy","B":"Describing the standard, everyday respirator practice already used under normal, non-crisis operating conditions","C":"Using a single respirator to treat several different pathogens at once with little other precautionary adjustment made","D":"Describing a practice for which fairly limited CDC guidance or crisis-capacity recommendation currently exists"}}
source_row.rationale: Extended use of N95 respirators, wearing the same respirator continuously for multiple client encounters without removal, is a CDC-outlined crisis capacity strategy used only during severe shortages, not standard practice.
source_row.source_name: CDC — Strategies for Optimizing PPE Supplies
